ai_summary: Amrutanjan Health Care Limited reported strong FY2026 performance with 11% revenue growth and 25% profit before tax growth (before exceptional items), primarily propelled by its Pain Management and Women's Hygiene segments. The company is actively diversifying its portfolio and investing heavily in distribution, digital channels, and a new sanitary napkin manufacturing plant to drive future growth. A notable red flag is the severe and prolonged regulatory challenges impacting the electrolyte drink category, which has hindered its performance over the past three years.
